name: The Promise of Forever
source:
You've let your parents arrange the perfect marriage, but the man they find is nothing like what you expected... even if he is irresistible.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Promise_of_Forever,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
